origins.section: 8.2 A Participant Writes Its Own Event, and Only If Its Element Names a Logger
8.1 The Transaction Event Says Who Voted, Never Why
8.4 The TransactionManager Times Participants; a Profiler of Your Own Times the Steps
8.5 A Transaction That Never Ends Writes Nothing, and the Ones After It Show Where It Is

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-participant-without-logger: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-participant-without-logger: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-participant-without-logger: 8.2: the factory calls setLogger only when the participant element has a logger attribute, and without it the log has nothing from the participant.
recorded.prompt:q-caught-exception: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-caught-exception: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-caught-exception: 8.1: ctx.log writes into a LogEvent in the Context, printed only in the Context dump; the 8.7 table gives nowhere with debug-context false.
recorded.prompt:q-checkpoints-in-production: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-checkpoints-in-production: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-checkpoints-in-production: 8.4: ctx.checkPoint writes into the Context, so it shows only in the dump; the TransactionManager's profiler keeps the single participant line.
recorded.prompt:q-tail-not-moving: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-tail-not-moving: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-tail-not-moving: 8.5: tail is the oldest transaction that hasn't finished, and a stuck one holds tail while head moves.

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-participant-without-logger:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-participant-without-logger:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-participant-without-logger:a: 8.2: logger and realm are set only when the element has a logger attribute, so realm alone gives no output.
recorded.prompt:q-participant-without-logger:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-participant-without-logger:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-participant-without-logger:b: 8.1 and 8.3: the TransactionManager's event lists votes; the participant's event is a separate entry.
recorded.prompt:q-participant-without-logger:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-participant-without-logger:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-participant-without-logger:d: 8.7 table: a participant's own event appears with debug-context false if the element has logger; only ctx.log depends on the dump.
recorded.prompt:q-caught-exception:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-caught-exception:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-caught-exception:a: 8.1: the TransactionManager writes a warn only for an exception that escapes prepare, and this one was caught.
recorded.prompt:q-caught-exception:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-caught-exception:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-caught-exception:b: 8.1: the event lists participants and votes, and the ctx.log text appears nowhere in it.
recorded.prompt:q-caught-exception:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-caught-exception:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-caught-exception:c: 8.3 (3): the filter replaces each ISOMsg with a masked copy and leaves every other entry, an exception included, as it is.
recorded.prompt:q-checkpoints-in-production:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-checkpoints-in-production:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-checkpoints-in-production:b: 8.4 and 8.7: checkpoints appear only in the Context's PROFILER entry in the dump, regardless of the participant's own event.
recorded.prompt:q-checkpoints-in-production:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-checkpoints-in-production:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-checkpoints-in-production:c: 8.4: none of the checkpoints appear in the TransactionManager's profiler.
recorded.prompt:q-checkpoints-in-production:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-checkpoints-in-production:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-checkpoints-in-production:d: 8.4: the participant's 729.3 ms line is still there, with no step lines in its place.
recorded.prompt:q-tail-not-moving:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-tail-not-moving:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-tail-not-moving:a: 8.5 and 8.7: outstanding counts queued Contexts; tail is the oldest unfinished transaction id.
recorded.prompt:q-tail-not-moving:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-tail-not-moving:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-tail-not-moving:c: 8.5: tail moves when the oldest unfinished transaction ends, not only on a restart.
recorded.prompt:q-tail-not-moving:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-tail-not-moving:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-tail-not-moving:d: 8.5 and 8.7: tail is the oldest unfinished id, not the first id since a restart.
